text_block_list.text:
In their 1,200-meter race-format showdown, 
Calstone Light O had yet to claim a single 
victory against Sakura Bakushin O.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Gh, couldn't pull ahead 
again...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, I ran hard so no one could pass 
me.

Sakura Bakushin O took the lead and 
positioned herself to hinder Calstone 
Light O from running at full throttle.

There will likely be other Umamusume using 
the same tactic. To overcome this, we'll 
need to train acceleration even further.

However, Calstone Light O's running is 
already bringing out 100% of her potential 
as it stands. Therefore, in order to 
become even faster――
choice_data_list:
From now on, we need to raise your 
baseline abilities.

From now on, we need to bring out more of 
your true potential.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Raising our fundamental strength will make 
us faster, right? Let's get to it right 
away!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I'll help too! So, what should I do?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Gugugu... *hrrrngh*...!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
All right, tweet, tweet! Ooh, you're 
pulling that tire in a perfectly straight 
line!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Haa... Starting uphill... is really 
tough...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I haven't accelerated well at all. 
Please, one more rep!”

Acceleration is all in the kicking power. 
I'll aim to build muscle with tire pulling 
and uphill slope training.

"However, this training puts a heavy load 
on the body. We must be careful to avoid 
injuries and breakdowns from fatigue."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Grrrrrr. Stretching slowly...
choice_data_list: Right, make sure to stretch thoroughly.
Right, be sure to stretch thoroughly.

text_block_list.text:
I am carrying out thorough maintenance, 
but... Because she is so fast, the strain 
on her legs is immense as it is.

Is it really okay to push her this 
hard...?

One day, with such anxieties constantly 
haunting me—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I'm finished with the uphill track.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: *chug chug chug*... Phew!

Is that some kind of colored aura 
radiating from Calstone Light O's 
hands...?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: What is the matter? Trainer.

The crimson that slowly seeped out even 
dyed the air around Calstone Light O a 
deep shade of red.
choice_data_list:
Everything around you is completely red, 
though...
Um, there's something red around you...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Oh, you're right. I wonder why.
choice_data_list: Don't you have any idea?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Not in the slightest.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Ah... It's gone.

The lingering red hue faded smoothly and 
vanished. Was it caused by the change 
before and after? If so—
choice_data_list:
Was it because of that drink from 
earlier...?

text_block_list.text:
Spot on! That was smoke drifting from the 
chemical reaction in the drink.

Amidst the applause, Agnes Tachyon 
appeared. No way...
choice_data_list: Light O, where did you get that drink?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I got it from Tachyon. She said it's a 
drink with an outstanding fatigue-recovery 
effect.
choice_data_list: So that means it's handmade by her, huh...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, Trainer, no need to make that 
face. It's merely a fatigue recovery 
drink.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Other than turning into warning colors, 
that is.
choice_data_list: A warning...? About what?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
When that drink mixes with saliva and 
detects a certain level of lactic acid, it 
emits red smoke.

Turning red means lactate levels are 
high... in other words, the muscles are 
fatigued, correct?
choice_data_list: Light O, aren't you tired?
Light O, you seem tired, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. I have more energy than before 
training.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Runner's high. A state where 
beta-endorphins are secreted, providing 
analgesic and stress-relieving effects.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I don't think there's anything less 
reliable than Right O-kun saying 'I'm not 
tired,' you know?

"Indeed. Calstone Light O has a 
tremendously strong desire to reach top 
speed."

A synergy between sheer willpower and a 
runner's high could make her less 
susceptible to fatigue. Even so...
choice_data_list: Why did you give this drink to Right O?
Why did you give this drink to Right O?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it obvious? I'm intrigued! By the 
"top speed" you're aiming for, Light 
O-kun!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Top speed! The pursuit of the ultimate 
velocity possible for an Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Just how much potential lies dormant 
within an Umamusume's body? Can instinct 
overcome physical limits?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"What will this most quintessential 
Umamusume challenge bring to the 
Umamusume, and to their history?!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I want to know! The result! The answer! I 
want to see it no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Beyond the searing afterglow—push forward!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I don't get it at all!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Your explanations are always so 
convoluted. Be more concise!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Let me help you reach your top speed.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Got it. Now help me out!
choice_data_list: Really!?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
It's the same as Bakushin O. This time, 
it's Light × Light.
choice_data_list:
I see... Well, if that's what Right O 
wants.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, are you sure? Making such a quick 
decision. As a Trainer, wouldn't you want 
to confirm the details of my cooperation 
first?"

It's not that I don't have concerns, of 
course. But—
choice_data_list:
Because this is the path Light O will 
take.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—, hmm... Then I shall gratefully accept 
your pure, innocent goodwill.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I'm counting on you, Light O.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: *gulp*, *gulp*, *gulp*...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, it's not turning red. Looks like 
fatigue won't be an issue!

Agnes Tachyon's drink was actually 
helpful. It makes it easy to pinpoint the 
borderline where training becomes 
excessive.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Trainer, I've made something 
new here.
choice_data_list: ...What kind of drink is that?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
A drink where "no matter how much you run, 
you never get tired." Though "getting 
better at counterclockwise tracks" or 
"doubling your kicking power" work too.
choice_data_list: What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
To tell you the truth, it's just regular 
colored water. However, if you drink it 
believing it has such effects, it might 
just work that way... perhaps.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: It's what you call the placebo effect.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Right O-kun is exceptionally pure and 
straightforward. That type is very 
susceptible to suggestion. Therefore, even 
a placebo should prove highly effective.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Through the synergy of training and 
autosuggestion, she might achieve results 
that exceed expectations.

So it buffs the results of my training. As 
long as the ingredients are harmless, I 
suppose there is no harm in trying it.
choice_data_list: Let me make sure that's really just water.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Ahaha, wonderful! Should I expect nothing 
less from Light O's Trainer? You intend to 
devote yourself to that light as well!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Kukuku... Go ahead, won't you?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ghk, so close! Just a little more and I 
would've beaten Bakushin O!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I was surprised. To think you'd get this 
fast out of nowhere.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to Tachyon's drink! You're 
amazing, Tachyon!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well now, it's remarkably effective! 
Kukuku, this makes experimenting all the 
more worthwhile.

...I don't know what Agnes Tachyon's 
intentions are in offering to cooperate. 
But...

She suffered an injury after the Satsuki 
Sho and entered a long period of 
rehabilitation. There is still no prospect 
of her return.

She must have her own thoughts on the 
matter. If Calstone Light O's running is 
what drew her in, then—

All that's left is to get there and show 
them.
Calstone Light O's top-speed running—
